facts.note: Twenty-seven blocks west to east: the walled pass, fifteen across inside its ring, and hillside either side.
Fifty-seven blocks south to north: the pass, the toll bar at its head, the road beyond, and hillside round them.
Thirty-seven blocks from the foot of the pass to the toll bar: four strongrooms in its walls, a walk of under a minute if a body stops at none of them.
Fifteen blocks across the pass: a road five wide down the middle, and five blocks of wall on each side that the strongrooms are cut into.
